title: Do Not Download This App - Extremely Disappointing Experience
body: I downloaded this app hoping for a positive experience, but it turned into a nightmare. First, the app didn't even work properly on my phone. Despite deleting it and contacting support, I was charged multiple times without authorization. The customer service was unhelpful and slow to respond, leaving me frustrated and out of pocket.Their so-called "Money-Back Policy" is misleading, making it nearly impossible to get a refund even when you follow all their instructions. This app is a complete scam, preying on unsuspecting users. I strongly advise against downloading it unless you want to deal with unauthorized charges and poor customer service. Save yourself the trouble and avoid this app at all costs.
